newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 21.05 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 21.05 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate (TIIE) fell by 30 basis points to 21.05 percent on Wednesday from 21.35 percent on Tuesday, Banco de Mexico said.
The 28-day TIIP rose 44.26 basis points to 21.0391 percent on Wednesday from 20.5965 percent the week before.
The 91-day TIIE meanwhile fell 15 basis points to 21.85 percent on Wednesday from 22.00.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
